built.what: Summary tiles and recent-activity feed for the org's books.
Double-entry ledger; every posting has balanced debit/credit lines (database enforces balance). List, void, approve.
Multi-line entry form with a live debits-vs-credits total and balanced check. Manual-source entries are flagged in the review queue. No templates, attachments, recurrence or auto-reversal.
Posted entries are never edited; a void or reversing entry is posted instead. Field-level audit log on every ledger write.
Configurable approval rules; export of policy; a review queue of flagged transactions.
Spending against a grant marked federal needs a different person to approve (2 CFR 200.303). Grant must be flagged federal for it to fire.
Non-dollar KPIs (clients served) kept in the chart of accounts but excluded from all dollar totals.
Connect a bank, map accounts, manual 'sync now'. Webhook path is coded but untested against a real delivery.
Enter a statement date and ending balance; the report compares it with the ledger. Whether a signed-off report is saved per month is not confirmed.
Match bank lines to bills/invoices/payments/grant gifts; multi-match; transfers between accounts; unreconcile; discussion thread per line; reconciliation report.
Code unmatched bank lines to account/program/grant; bulk coding; suggestion from the most recent similar line.
Saved rules (substring + amount range) that pre-fill coding. Never post automatically. Rule edit/retire.
Create/submit/approve/pay (partial payments supported); edit lock once approved except due date/reference; $15K+ procurement-quote gate.
Apply or void against bills.
Create and deactivate recurring bill templates.
W-9/tax-ID capture (encrypted), 1099-NEC/MISC threshold tracking by calendar year ($2,000 from 2026 payments), summary and export. No e-filing.
Upload a bill; header fields prefilled. Not click-tested end to end after the last fixes.
Create/send/pay/void/write off; metadata-only edits after sending; AR aging.
Personal-funds reimbursement: receipt OCR prefill, receipt-latitude/affidavit for missing receipts, pre-approval or post-payout confirmation, mileage lines.
Straight-line depreciation run (human-triggered), disposal with gain/loss, feeds Form 990 Schedule D.
Land unposted, post on confirm; void.
Present-value discounting and accretion postings; gross face value and rate kept on the gift record.
Three orderings handled: grant first, bank first, bank first before grant exists (suspense account 'Unallocated Donor Receipts' reclassified later).
Computes MTDC base from ledger expenses minus flagged exclusions; warns when subawards exist (cannot compute that exclusion).
Xero-style condition builder; posts correcting journal, never edits lines in place; blocks system accounts.
Designations tracked as net assets without donor restriction.
Who must approve what, and thresholds.
Net assets split with/without donor restrictions. Computed live from the ledger. CSV export.
Revenue/expenses by net-asset class; explicit 'released from restriction' row. CSV.
Natural x functional matrix (program, management & general, fundraising). CSV.
Indirect method; ties to balance-sheet cash in testing. Non-cash flag on accounts. CSV.
Not available: statements return 'not available' for orgs whose actuals come from Xero.

Board report, grant reports, giving summary, budget, cash forecast page, donation receipt PDF. AR/AP aging lives in Purchases/Sales and the dashboard, not the Reports index. No standalone trial balance or general-ledger detail report found.
Admin can lock a whole fiscal year and reopen it with a reason; controls and the tie-out view sit in Reports > Reconciliation. No month-level lock.
Single contact list with vendor and customer role flags. Origin was donor-CRM, so its 'type' list is donor-shaped.
Schedule D, Schedule J (officer comp), Part IX functional expense editor, obligations calendar.
Roles in use: admin, finance (older name staff), fundraising, program, editor, convener, vendor, donor. Admin-only on recode, approval policy and similar. No read-only auditor role.
Filterable who-changed-what log across accounting tables.
CSV import for accounts, budget lines etc. Import-preview exists as a process, not as a tab.

planned.item: Plain cash donations through the Gift Postings flow
planned.what: Grant gifts and in-kind gifts land as unposted items and post on confirm. Ordinary cash donations with no grant have no equivalent path today.

planned.item: Award vs. allocation vs. actual-cash reconciliation
planned.what: Three numbers can silently drift: grant award, budget allocations by year/program, cash actually received. Nothing flags the difference.

planned.item: Per-program split when matching a grant deposit
planned.what: A deposit codes to the grant's single primary program even if the grant funds several programs.

planned.item: Auto-mark a pledge installment collected
planned.what: When the matching deposit posts, the installment stays 'expected' until someone marks it by hand.

planned.item: Per-subaward tracking for MTDC
planned.what: The subaward portion above $50,000 (was $25,000 before Oct 2024) is excluded from MTDC. Today we only warn; we cannot compute it.

planned.item: SEFA (Schedule of Expenditures of Federal Awards)
planned.what: Data fields exist on grants (assistance listing no., agency, pass-through). No SEFA report is built; needed for a Single Audit.

planned.item: Financial statements for Xero-sourced orgs
planned.what: Statements only work when the internal ledger is the source of truth.

planned.item: Actuals source toggle (Xero vs internal ledger) UI
planned.what: The setting exists in the database with no screen. Design question first: what happens to the superseded actuals when switching back.

planned.item: Unmapped actuals shown in the UI
planned.what: Actuals with an account but no program are computed server-side as 'unallocated' but not displayed. Actuals with no account mapping are dropped from budget-vs-actual entirely.

planned.item: Warning when a grant has no revenue account
planned.what: Grants without a revenue account are silently left out of budget write-through.

planned.item: Webhook signature check against a real delivery
planned.what: Manual sync is verified; automatic webhook sync needs a public HTTPS callback to test. Production-readiness item.

planned.item: End-to-end test of OCR on bills, invoices, credit notes, expense claims
planned.what: Code-checked only; no real file upload test since the last fixes.

planned.item: Line-item proposal from OCR (not just header)
planned.what: Account and program can't be read from a document; v1 prefills header only. Open: propose lines? auto-create vendor? (current answer: never auto-create).

planned.item: Formula entry in all money fields
planned.what: '=192+268.50' works in bills, invoices, expense claims only. Budget grid deliberately excluded for now.

planned.item: Recode history page; recode contact; tax-rate field
planned.what: Xero has a Recode History page. Today recodes are visible in the Activity Log only.

planned.item: Other depreciation methods
planned.what: Straight-line only (what nonprofit GAAP reporting overwhelmingly uses).

planned.item: Suggest registering an asset when a bill line is over the threshold
planned.what: Needs an answer on a per-org capitalization threshold (federal $10,000 is a floor, not every org's policy).

planned.item: Scheduled (automatic) depreciation
planned.what: Deliberately human-triggered, same principle as Bank Rules.

planned.item: Partial payment of a claim
planned.what: Claim must be paid in full today.

planned.item: Per-line receipt requirements / dollar thresholds
planned.what: Mirrors the bill procurement-quote gate.

planned.item: Org-wide mileage rate setting
planned.what: Rate is entered on each line today.

planned.item: Corporate card import / reconciliation
planned.what: Different feature from reimbursements; closer to Bank Reconciliation.

planned.item: Auto-apply with no confirmation; regex/OR conditions; split-coding rules; retroactive apply
planned.what: All explicitly excluded from v1 to keep a human in the loop.

planned.item: E-filing of 1099s
planned.what: Tracking and export only.

planned.item: Role-based access beyond 'admin'; auditor view-only role
planned.what: Eight roles exist and gate routes (see Built B-Roles). Still no read-only auditor/outside-accountant role, and no per-action matrix for finance tasks (e.g. who may approve vs post vs reconcile).

planned.item: Nightly integrity check + integrity log + drill-down
planned.what: Planned job that runs invariant checks (schedule sums, duplicates, orphaned lines) and shows pass/warn/fail.

planned.item: GL reconciliation view for imported Xero actuals
planned.what: Compare GL balance to budget-actual rows per account; status reconciled / discrepancy / unreviewed.

planned.item: Login / record-access history
planned.what: Data changes are logged; sign-ins and views are not.

planned.item: Xero write-back (push journals/bills/invoices to Xero)
planned.what: Only account-name push exists. Matters only for orgs that keep Xero as primary.

planned.item: Contracts module (sibling to Grants)
planned.what: Deferred pending Xero generalization.

planned.item: Activity-level budgeting
planned.what: Budget lines can't be entered at activity level; needs a roll-up design decision. Matters for activity-based cost reporting.

planned.item: Per-program fiscal year
planned.what: Fiscal year is org-level only.

planned.item: Rename one of the two 'Compliance' features
planned.what: Sidebar 'Compliance' (990/obligations) vs 'vendor compliance' (W-9) under Purchases.

planned.item: Contact 'type' list fits vendors/customers
planned.what: Type dropdown is donor-shaped (foundation/individual/board/prospect/member org); no 'business we pay'.

planned.item: Unified contacts (Membership people are a separate table)
planned.what: Members live in their own table, not in Contacts.

planned.item: Payment execution (ACH/check/card from inside the app)
planned.what: Parked on purpose: money-transmitter liability. Recording a payment already works.

planned.item: Multi-currency
planned.what: Needed for a future European build; every amount is a plain integer without a currency today.

ideas.idea: Month-end close checklist
ideas.why: A per-month checklist (bank reconciled, bills/invoices cut off, accruals, depreciation run, payroll tied out, board designations updated, then lock). Shows what's blocking the lock. Most close tools (Aplos, QBO close checklist) have this.
ideas.source: Industry practice; builds on built fiscal-year lock

ideas.idea: Lock by month, not only fiscal year
ideas.why: Today the lock is by fiscal year. Bookkeepers normally lock each closed month.

ideas.idea: Accrual / prepaid / deferred revenue entries with auto-reversal
ideas.why: Recurring adjusting journals (prepaid insurance, accrued payroll, deferred grants) that auto-reverse next period.

ideas.idea: Journal templates, recurring and auto-reversing journals, attachments
ideas.why: A manual journal form exists (balanced check, review flag). Missing: saved templates, recurrence, auto-reverse, file attachments, import from spreadsheet.

ideas.idea: Saved, signed-off monthly bank reconciliations
ideas.why: A report against an entered ending balance exists. Idea: keep one per account per month with preparer/reviewer sign-off and a lock on reconciled lines.

ideas.idea: Duplicate and 'looks wrong' detection on feed lines
ideas.why: Flag same-amount-same-day duplicates, round-number outliers, and vendors with sudden amount jumps.

ideas.idea: Credit card statement import (CSV/OFX) without Plaid
ideas.why: Many small orgs have no Plaid-supported connection. CSV/OFX upload with the same coding and rules flow.

ideas.idea: Auto-apply rules with confidence tiers
ideas.why: After a rule has a clean track record, optionally apply it on import to lines under a dollar limit, still leaving them 'unconfirmed'.

ideas.idea: Bill intake by email (forward to a unique address)
ideas.why: Vendor emails a PDF; it lands in a review queue pre-filled by OCR. Bill.com/Dext/Ramp do this. Inbound email infrastructure (Postmark) already exists for other uses.

ideas.idea: Batch pay and payment-run files (NACHA/check run export)
ideas.why: Select approved bills, produce a payment file or check list to be executed outside the app. Stays on the right side of the 'we don't move money' decision.

ideas.idea: Three-way match (PO, receipt, bill)
ideas.why: Likely too heavy for small orgs; ask whether purchase orders matter at all.

ideas.idea: Vendor self-service portal (submit W-9, see payment status)
ideas.why: Named in the comprehensive plan as reasonable to build without payment rails.

ideas.idea: Customer statements and dunning reminders
ideas.why: Automated AR reminders and monthly statements.

ideas.idea: Pledge and grant receivable aging
ideas.why: Aging of pledges and grants receivable the same way invoices age; allowance for uncollectible pledges.

ideas.idea: Fund accounting view (restricted funds roll-forward)
ideas.why: Net-asset roll-forward by fund and by restriction purpose/time, with releases. We have class-level releases; a per-fund roll-forward is what many auditors ask for.

ideas.idea: Restriction tracking against grant spend
ideas.why: Warn when spending against a restricted grant exceeds the award or falls outside its period/budget categories.

ideas.idea: Net-asset release by time (pledges with time restrictions)
ideas.why: Automatic release when a time restriction expires.

ideas.idea: Shared-cost allocation engine (rent, utilities, admin) by percent, headcount, square footage
ideas.why: Allocation schedules exist for indirect costs; ask whether bookkeepers want monthly posted allocations to programs and funders.

ideas.idea: Time-and-effort / payroll allocation capture
ideas.why: Federal awards require personnel cost support (timesheets or effort certifications).

ideas.idea: Payroll journal import (Gusto/ADP/Paychex) with automatic split
ideas.why: Import a payroll register and post the journal across programs by employee allocation, including taxes and benefits liabilities.

ideas.idea: Trial balance and general ledger detail reports
ideas.why: No standalone trial balance or GL detail report found in Reports. Bookkeepers and auditors ask for both first.

ideas.idea: Budget vs. actual by program/grant on the internal ledger with drill-down
ideas.why: Click a variance to see transactions. Check how this behaves today for ledger-sourced orgs.

ideas.idea: Board-ready financial package (one PDF: statements + variance narrative + cash)
ideas.why: Single exportable pack each month/quarter.

ideas.idea: Funder financial reports by grant (cash basis and accrual)
ideas.why: A report per grant showing budget, spend by line, indirect applied, remaining. A grant report exists; ask whether it matches what funders ask for.

ideas.idea: Reports scheduled by email
ideas.why: Auto-send aging, close status, or board pack to chosen recipients.

ideas.idea: Year-over-year and 12-month trend comparatives on statements
ideas.why: Comparative columns are standard in audited nonprofit statements.

ideas.idea: Form 990 line-item worksheet (Parts VIII, IX, X from the ledger)
ideas.why: Part IX exists; Parts VIII (revenue) and X (balance sheet) mapping would complete a 990 prep package.

ideas.idea: Auditor / PBC (prepared-by-client) request list and binder
ideas.why: A checklist of what a CPA asks for at audit time with links to the documents and reports. Document Vault/Audit Binder already exists.

ideas.idea: Read-only auditor / outside-accountant role with expiring access
ideas.why: Time-limited view-only access that cannot see unrelated modules.

ideas.idea: Journal-entry testing view (unusual entries: weekends, round amounts, post-close, same-user create+approve)
ideas.why: What auditors run. Cheap to produce from the audit log.

ideas.idea: Segregation-of-duties check dashboard
ideas.why: Flags where one person created, approved, and reconciled the same item; options for small orgs where that is unavoidable.

ideas.idea: Gift acknowledgement and tax receipt rules (quid pro quo, $250 / $75 disclosures)
ideas.why: Receipt PDF exists; check disclosure wording logic for goods/services received.

ideas.idea: State sales/use tax or UBIT tracking
ideas.why: UBIT (unrelated business income) tracking for orgs with earned revenue. Sales tax/VAT is on our skip list.

ideas.idea: Payroll / contractor annual filings (W-2, 1099) hand-off exports
ideas.why: Export in the format filing services accept. We do not e-file.

ideas.idea: Opening balances and migration wizard from QuickBooks/Xero
ideas.why: Import chart of accounts, opening trial balance, and open bills/invoices for a mid-year switch. Budget onboarding wizard is a related idea.

ideas.idea: Chart-of-accounts templates for nonprofits (e.g. Unified Chart of Accounts / NCCS)
ideas.why: Pick a standard chart at setup; map to 990 lines automatically.

ideas.idea: Attachments on every transaction with required-document rules
ideas.why: Require receipt/invoice/approval doc over a threshold, with retention rules.

ideas.idea: Multi-entity / sponsored-project separate books
ideas.why: Full fund separation for a fiscal sponsor's projects, with combined and standalone statements.

ideas.idea: Bookkeeper workspace across several client orgs
ideas.why: One login, many client nonprofits, with a work queue (what's unreconciled, what's overdue for close). The org-membership model is per-org today.

ideas.idea: AI-assisted coding review
ideas.why: Surface likely miscoded transactions (e.g. same vendor coded two ways) for human review. Never auto-post.

questions.question: Should a small org (2-3 person finance team) be able to let one person both record and approve/classify? Is a read-only field in one screen a sufficient control, or do we need real role enforcement?
questions.why: Our grant-revenue account design assumes recording and authorizing are separate roles. We inferred that from general segregation-of-duties guidance, not from a standard.

questions.question: Is the 'land as unposted, then explicit confirm' step the right friction? Comparable unified platforms auto-post and put control upstream (who sets up fund-to-account mappings).
questions.why: This is our own requirement, not validated against comparable products. Which flows deserve auto-posting?

questions.question: Is 'Unallocated Donor Receipts' correctly a liability? Should it be a clearing account with no GAAP type, or treated like deferred revenue?
questions.why: Money sits there until classified. If it crosses a period end it shows as a liability though it may economically be revenue.

questions.question: Should we require reclassifying suspense before period close, and block the lock if a balance remains?
Is posting accretion straight to the receivable (no separate 'Discount on pledges receivable' contra account) acceptable, or does an auditor expect to see gross receivable and discount separately?
questions.why: We keep gross face value and discount rate on the gift record, but the ledger shows only the net.

questions.question: Is computing MTDC from ledger expense accounts minus a per-account exclusion flag a reasonable approach? Which exclusions do small orgs most often miss (participant support, equipment, tuition, rent of off-site)?
questions.why: We warn about subawards but cannot compute that exclusion.

questions.question: What does a clean month-end look like for you, step by step? Which steps would you want the app to track?
Do you lock by month or only at year end? Do you ever reopen a locked period, and how do you document it?
questions.why: Today we lock by fiscal year with a reopen reason.

questions.question: Do you reconcile to the statement's ending balance each month? We have a report that takes the ending balance; is that enough, or do you need a saved, signed-off record per month?
questions.why: Decides whether saved monthly reconciliations are needed.

questions.question: Which chart of accounts structure do you start clients on? Do you use classes/tags/programs instead of sub-accounts?
questions.why: We use account + program + grant dimensions. Check it matches real practice.

questions.question: Where does coding take you the most time today, and what would save the most?
questions.why: Prioritizes rules, OCR, email intake, and AI review.

questions.question: How do you track a grant's budget vs. spend per line today? What does a funder expect on a financial report?
questions.why: Check our grant report against actual funder templates.

questions.question: How does payroll reach the books (journal from provider, bank-only, or entered by hand)? Any allocation by program?
What do your clients' CPAs ask for at audit time that you have to dig up by hand?
Are you comfortable with a missing-receipt affidavit path for expense claims? What threshold and wording do you use?
questions.why: We built a 60-day follow-up and affidavit.

questions.question: Is tracking + export enough, or do clients expect to file from the tool? How do you decide what's reportable (card payments excluded, etc.)?
questions.why: We track calendar-year totals and cap mixed-bill amounts.

questions.question: Do the labels (Cash Coding, Gift Postings, Board Designations, Find & Recode) make sense to a bookkeeper, or do you use different terms?
questions.why: Our labels came from Xero/Aplos and our own terms.

questions.question: Which tools do your clients use now (QBO, Xero, Aplos, spreadsheets)? What would make switching realistic, and what would be a deal-breaker?
What do you wish we would NOT build?

readme.text: Accounting module — bookkeeper review workbook
Prepared 2026-10-01. Source: Causal's own plan files, specs and review notes, checked against the live code on that date. Nothing here has been shared outside the owner yet.
WHAT WE ARE ASKING
1. Tell us whether what is already built matches how a working bookkeeper actually does the job (tab 'Built - Review').
2. Tell us which of the planned-but-unbuilt items matter in practice, and in what order (tab 'Planned - Unbuilt').
3. React to ideas we have not committed to (tab 'Ideas - Aspirational'). These are suggestions from outside research, not promises.
4. Answer the accounting-judgment questions we could not settle from published sources (tab 'Questions').
5. Add anything we missed (tab 'Their Additions').
HOW TO FILL IT IN
Yellow columns are for the bookkeeper. Grey/white columns are ours. Use the dropdowns where offered; free-text comments are the most valuable part.
Items marked 'Verify' in the 'Confidence' column are claims from our notes we have not re-checked against the running app. Treat them as questions, not facts.
Please say what you would do in your own practice (QuickBooks, Xero, Aplos, spreadsheets), not what you think we want to hear. 'We would never use that' is a useful answer.
PROCESS (suggested, about 4 sessions over 3-4 weeks)

Step 0 - Setup (owner, 30 min): give the bookkeeper a login to the Demo Company workspace (confirm the current slug first; it changes if the org is renamed). Send this sheet plus docs/Grant_Accounting_Test_Walkthrough.md. Do not give access to any real org's data.

Step 1 - Guided tour (60-90 min, screen share): walk Accounting tab by tab in the order on 'Built - Review'. Bookkeeper talks aloud while we take notes straight into the sheet. Goal: first reactions, not detailed review.

Step 2 - Solo hands-on (bookkeeper, 2-4 hours over a week): run a month-end in the demo org (code bank lines, enter a bill, an invoice, an expense claim, a depreciation run, lock the month/year). Fill in the yellow columns on 'Built - Review'.

Step 3 - Triage session (60 min): go through 'Planned - Unbuilt' and 'Ideas' together. Bookkeeper rates each; we agree a short ranked list (aim for no more than 8 items) and mark them in the 'Decision' column.

Step 4 - Judgment questions (45 min): the 'Questions' tab. These need a professional opinion (GAAP presentation, internal controls for small orgs). Record the answer and the reasoning, not just yes/no.
Step 5 - Build, then re-review: we build the ranked list, the bookkeeper re-tests each shipped item and flips its status to Verified. Repeat from Step 3 with the next batch.
RULES OF THE ROAD
- The bookkeeper is reviewing, not approving payroll or posting real books. Use demo data only until we agree otherwise.
- Anything touching what the app does with real money (payment execution) is deliberately parked; ignore it unless you have a strong view.
- Causal posts to the ledger only after a person confirms inside Accounting. If that feels like extra friction compared with your usual tool, say so on the 'Questions' tab (Q1).
- When a comment becomes a decision, copy it into the 'Decision' column with a date so we do not re-argue it.
TABS
Built - Review | Planned - Unbuilt | Ideas - Aspirational | Questions | Their Additions | Decision Log
